payload._note: NeoGenomics (NEO) provides oncology diagnostic testing services to community-based pathologists, oncologists, hospital pathology labs, reference labs, academic centers, and pharmaceutical companies. The 10-K does not disclose any specific named customers meeting the 10% SEC threshold. Revenue appears to be recurring through diagnostic testing services rather than project-based. The Clinical Services segment (84% of revenue) serves healthcare providers, while the Advanced Diagnostics segment (16% of revenue) serves pharmaceutical companies through clinical trials and research services. Note 16 mentions minimal related-party revenue from HOOKIPA Pharma ($0.4M) and CytomX Therapeutics ($0.7M in 2022), which are immaterial. Note 15 references ongoing federal healthcare program revenue under investigation, but no specific customer concentrations are disclosed. The company operates in a fragmented market serving many healthcare providers and pharmaceutical clients without concentration risk requiring disclosure.
